scheme_name: Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Maharashtra.
Must belong to the Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) community.
Parents' annual income must not exceed Rs. 24,000.
Must be studying in 4th standard (or higher) for merit‑based admission.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance to the institution, 100% salary for staff, and free educational supplies, lodging, boarding, plus a stipend of ₹1450 per month per residential student.
